title: Upgradeable Spawners
description: Upgrade spawners' speed, range & activation range
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/54ad7992a90f9139a4d067e899489204dfbe0a83.png)

[![wiki](https://img.shields.io/badge/Wiki-gray?logo=googledocs&logoColor=gold)](https://yoavtc.github.io/upgradeable-spawners/) [![git](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/yoavtc/upgradeable-spawners?logo=github)](https://github.com/YoavTC/upgradeable-spawners/releases)

[![PM](https://img.shields.io/badge/𝗣𝗠-%20Planet%20Minecraft-gray)](https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/upgradeable-spawners/)

_**Upgrade a spawner's properties!**_

Surround the spawner with **Lapis Lazuli** to upgrade it's Spawn Range, **Creaking Heart** to upgrade it's Activation Distance, and **Sculk Catalyst** to upgrade it's Spawn Speed!
